name: ASUS Aura keyboards (ROG / TUF)
description: Per-key lighting of ASUS ROG and TUF keyboards over USB: ROG Strix Scope TKL family, ROG Azoth, Claymore, Falchion, Strix Flare / Flare II / Flare II Animate, Strix Scope / RX / NX Wireless Deluxe / Scope II / Scope II 96, TUF Gaming K1, K3, K3 Gen II, K5, K7. Adapted from OpenRGB's AsusAuraKeyboardController and AsusAuraTUFKeyboardController (GPL-2.0-or-later); untested on hardware. The save command and hardware effects are never sent. Protocol notes: docs/hardware/asus-aura-keyboard.md.
